page.title: Node bridge URL & token
page.description: The shared Node bridge every engine talks to — the Unofficial API sends through it and sender pacing is applied here. Set once; it applies platform-wide.
page.superOnly: Only a super admin can change the Node bridge. You can see the saved values.

bridge.urlInvalid: Enter a valid Server URL (http:// or https://) first.
bridge.serverUrlHint: Where your Node bridge is reachable. Inbound + status webhooks are handled automatically — the bridge picks our URL up from its APP_DOMAIN_NAME env var.
bridge.tokenHint: Shared secret the Node bridge sends as X-Node-Token. Must match the token in your Node bridge config. Hidden after save; re-paste only to rotate.

pacing.title: Sender pacing & batching
pacing.tip: Lower the message gap only after a 24h soak — Meta throttles aggressive senders. 3 sec is the safe default.

unofficial.title: Unofficial WhatsApp (personal numbers via QR)
unofficial.explanation: We support the official WhatsApp Business API only. Turning this on lets workspaces connect personal numbers; it is unsupported and can get numbers banned.

state.disabled: Off. Workspaces cannot see or connect personal numbers: the QR connect flow, the Warmer and personal-number senders are hidden, and sends through them are refused.
state.enabled: On. Every workspace can connect personal numbers by QR code. This is unsupported; those numbers can be banned by WhatsApp.

enableDialog.title: Enable unofficial WhatsApp?
enableDialog.body: This is not supported. Numbers connected this way can be banned by WhatsApp, and messages sent through them are not covered by any delivery promise. It applies to every workspace on the platform.

disableDialog.title: Disable unofficial WhatsApp?
disableDialog.body: Workspaces will stop seeing personal numbers, the Warmer and the QR connect flow, and sends through personal numbers will be refused. Saved data is kept.

unofficial.dimNote: The settings below only apply to personal numbers and are not used while unofficial WhatsApp is disabled.
